name: askjev-mcp
description: Let Claude drive your browser in plain English. TypeSafe Jev decides each click; irreversible actions are frozen.
long_description:
AskJev lets Claude open sites, click, type and fill forms for you — you just talk.

Setup is this screen:

1. Paste your TypeSafe API key below (get one at https://typesafe.ai).
2. Click Install.

That is the whole setup. No terminal, no scripts, no ports to paste. AskJev opens Brave (or Chrome) itself when Claude needs it.

Every on-page decision comes from TypeSafe Jev System One — not from Claude guessing. Anything that looks irreversible (pay, delete, send, publish, deploy) is stopped and handed back to you.

Optional: the AskJev browser extension adds the same Guard to your OWN browsing. It is not needed for Claude to drive the browser.

tools.name: askjev_do
tools.description: Do what the user asked in the browser, end to end, in their own words

tools.name: askjev_stop
tools.description: Stop a running AskJev browser task

tools.name: askjev_status
tools.description: Whether AskJev can drive the browser right now

tools.name: askjev_snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot interactive elements on the current page

tools.name: askjev_act
tools.description: One DOM action: CLICK, TYPE_TEXT, SELECT, SCROLL_DOWN, SCROLL_UP, WAIT, PRESS

tools.name: askjev_click
tools.description: Click a visible button or link by its label

tools.name: askjev_read_page
tools.description: Read the visible text of the current page

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Get one at https://typesafe.ai. Jev uses it to decide each step. Stored by Claude, sent only to api.typesafe.ai.

browser_bin.title: Browser (optional)
browser_bin.description: Leave blank to use Brave, then Chrome, whichever is installed. Set a full path only to force a specific browser.

max_steps.title: Maximum steps per task
max_steps.description: How many actions AskJev may take for one request before stopping.
